Bose SoundLink Plus Portable Speaker – Powerful Bluetooth Speaker with 20 Hours Battery & IP67 Water Resistance

The Bose SoundLink Plus Portable Speaker is designed for music lovers who demand powerful performance, rugged durability, and seamless wireless connectivity. Built with premium materials like silicone, polycarbonate, steel, and nylon, this Bluetooth speaker delivers rich, immersive sound in a compact and travel-ready design. Whether you’re hosting a house party, heading to the beach, or planning an outdoor adventure, the ensures uninterrupted entertainment with up to 20 hours of battery life.

Engineered for crystal-clear audio performance, this produces deep bass, balanced mids, and crisp highs. With Party Mode (when enabling two speakers), you can pair two compatible speakers for an amplified stereo experience that fills any space with powerful sound. Although the device does not include a microphone and does not support audio cables, its advanced Bluetooth wireless connectivity ensures stable and seamless pairing with smartphones, tablets, and laptops.

Featuring IP67 water and dust resistance, the is built to withstand splashes, rain, dust, and outdoor conditions. Its rugged exterior and premium build materials provide enhanced durability while maintaining a sleek and modern appearance. The USB-C In/Out charging interface ensures fast and convenient charging, with a full recharge time of just 5 hours. The speaker’s compact dimensions of 30.59 x 17.5 x 13.15 cm and weight of 4.567 lb make it easy to carry while delivering robust audio output.

Designed for portability and performance, this wireless Bluetooth speaker is perfect for home entertainment, travel, outdoor gatherings, camping trips, and poolside parties. The long-lasting rechargeable battery ensures all-day playback without interruptions. Its durable construction using silicone, polycarbonate, steel, and nylon enhances shock resistance and longevity, making it a reliable companion for any environment.

If you’re searching for a premium with Bluetooth connectivity, extended battery life, and IP67 water resistance, the stands out as a top choice. Experience signature Bose sound quality combined with modern wireless convenience and rugged outdoor-ready design.

Key Features

  • Microphones: No Microphone
  • Sound Options: Party Mode (When Enabling Two Speakers)
  • Audio Cable Included: No
  • Water Resistant Rating: IP67 (Dustproof & Waterproof)
  • Battery Life: Up to 20 Hours Playback
  • Battery Charge Time: Approximately 5 Hours
  • Charging Interface: USB-C In/Out
  • Wireless Connectivity: Bluetooth
  • Product Dimensions: 30.59 x 17.5 x 13.15 cm
  • Weight: 4.567 lb
  • Product Material: Silicone, Polycarbonate, Steel, Nylon

Why Choose?

  • Premium sound performance with powerful bass
  • Long-lasting 20-hour battery for extended playback
  • IP67 water and dust resistance for outdoor use
  • Durable and rugged construction
  • Easy wireless Bluetooth pairing
  • USB-C fast charging support
  • Party Mode for enhanced stereo experience
